## About

Fulfen Labs keeps this knowledge base on forward deployed engineering: building, shipping and handing over AI
systems inside customers' organisations. Articles are researched and drafted in a private repository and published
only after review. Each claim is a sourced fact with its date, first-person experience, or labelled opinion.
